query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleNumber,
  s.saleType,
  s.finalAmount,
  c.name as customer_name,
  s.createdAt
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN partners c ON s.customerId = c.id
WHERE s.saleNumber = '8130002'
